wounds.noGM: A GM must be logged in to apply this result.

model.name: Damage model
model.hint: Revised Fractional Health records wounds by severity (a fraction of max HP) instead of subtracting HP, with shock, stunning, impairment, limb trauma, bleeding and weekly recovery. Standard leaves the Game Aid's own HP rules untouched.

minorBleeding.name: Track bleeding from Minor wounds and Scratches
minorBleeding.hint: Revised Fractional Health lets you ignore bleeding from Minor wounds and Scratches for simplicity (hemophiliacs always bleed). Turn this on to track it anyway.

result.noPain: Too juiced up to feel the pain

pain.severe: Severe Pain for {minutes} min, half Move and Dodge
pain.terrible: Terrible Pain for {minutes} min, half Move and Dodge

result.limbHolds: {limb} holds, at -1 to tasks with it until healed
result.dismembered: {limb} is destroyed (bleeds as a Massive wound)
result.vitalsBleeding: Losing 2 FP per second to bleeding
result.neckBleeding: Losing 1 FP per second to bleeding
result.broken: Broken: incapacitated, losing 2 FP per second

dead.decapitated: Third Critical cutting wound to the neck: decapitated
dead.fragile: Fragile (Unnatural): dead at the first Critical wound to the head or torso

card.ignored: {location}: {injury} injury is under 1/16 HP and is ignored
card.reducedAway: {location}: large-area injury reduces {injury} injury below a Scratch
card.limbGone: {location} is already destroyed and takes no further damage
card.crushingMinor: Minor wound from a blunt attack: bruised, not recorded
card.largeArea: Large-area injury: {n} level(s) less severe here
card.diffuse: Injury Tolerance (Diffuse): no worse than a Minor wound from a single blow
card.shockNext: Shock -{n} to DX and IQ on the next turn
card.shockNextPain: Shock -{n} on the next turn (only -{effective} more than the current pain)
card.shockNow: Shock -{n} to DX and IQ (applied now)
card.shockNowPain: Shock -{n} (applied now; only -{effective} more than the current pain)
card.shockAbsorbed: Shock -{n}: the current pain is as bad, and they don't stack
card.shockNoTurn: Shock -{n} on the next turn (not in combat, so not applied)
card.zeroFP: At 0 or less FP: an HT roll (Hard to Subdue adds) to do anything but talk or rest; failure means Do Nothing.
card.fpCheckHelp: Failure means unconsciousness (Hard to Subdue helps); failure by 5 or more means death (Hard to Kill helps).
card.actHelp: At 0 or less FP: HT roll to do anything but talk or rest this turn.

note.injuryTolerance: Injury Tolerance: no shock, stunning or impairment
note.noNewImpairment: No new impairment roll: not worse than a wound already rolled for
note.gawdawful: Gawdawful: half Move and Dodge, and -1 DX per Gawdawful wound

panel.title: Wounds
panel.bleedCheck: Bleeding check (HT to avoid losing FP this interval)
panel.adrenalineHint: Out of combat for a minute: the pain of the worst wound sets in until cleared
panel.noLingeringPain: No wound bad enough to cause pain (Moderate or worse).

help.bandage: One minute of First Aid on {location}: success makes it bleed one level less. One attempt per wound.
help.stabilize: A second First Aid roll, taking extra time (B424), on {location}: success stops the bleeding. One attempt per wound.
help.surgery: One hour of Surgery on {location}: success stops the bleeding.

recovery.title: Weekly recovery
recovery.help: One HT roll per wound; each success lowers that wound one severity level.

edit.title: Edit wound
edit.resetConfirm: Remove every wound, limb status and pain from this character?
edit.consequences: Roll the consequences (shock, stun, impairment, limb and location checks)
